title: Employee Offer Letter (California Exempt)
description: Offer letter for California exempt hires covering compensation, exempt-employee policies, and DecisionLayer arbitration.
when_needed: When hiring a California exempt employee and you need a short-form offer letter.

transforms.find: \[Select one of the following arbitration options.*?see https://decisionlayer\.ai\.
sending written notice to [Insert Email or Address]
transforms.replace: sending written notice to <mark>[Insert Email or Address]</mark>

transforms.find: [<mark>the Company's office at [location]/your home office (remote)] in </mark>[<mark>city, California</mark>]
transforms.replace: [<mark>the Company's office at [location]/your home office (remote)</mark>] in [<mark>city</mark>, California]

transforms.find: [<mark>once per month / semimonthly / every two weeks] basis.</mark>
transforms.replace: [<mark>once per month / semimonthly / every two weeks</mark>] basis.

fields.label: Letter date
fields.question: What date should appear on the offer letter?

fields.label: Employee name
fields.question: What is the employee's full name?

fields.label: Employee address
fields.question: What is the employee's mailing address?

fields.label: First name
fields.question: What first name should the letter use in the greeting?

fields.label: Duties
fields.question: In a phrase, what will they do?

fields.label: City
fields.question: Which California city is the place of employment?

fields.label: Annual salary
fields.question: What is the annual salary? Enter the number only, without a dollar sign (for example, 100,000).

fields.label: Pay cadence
fields.question: How often will they be paid?

fields.question: Where should the employee send a written arbitration opt-out notice (email or mailing address)?
